lines.text: Last time, random jumps drew a perfect triangle. Can randomness draw something alive?
This time there are four rules. Each one shrinks, tilts and moves a point.
Pick a rule at random, apply it, and mark the spot. Then repeat.
After a thousand jumps, it still looks like dust.
But after seventy thousand, a fern grows out of pure randomness.
Every leaf is a smaller copy of the whole fern. This is the Barnsley fern.
Change the numbers in the rules, and a different plant grows. What should we grow next?

post.title: 4 random rules grow a fern
post.description: Pick one of four simple rules at random, apply it, mark the point, repeat 70,000 times: the Barnsley fern appears. Made with code.
post.pinned_comment: Part 2 of the chaos game series. What should random jumps draw next?
